result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Contractor provides uncapped defense and indemnity to Company and its affiliates for third-party IP claims, legal violations, Contractor-caused data/confidentiality breaches, and gross negligence or wilful misconduct, with notice, defense control, settlement protections, and cooperation. The liability-cap and fee-waiver carveouts are necessary to make that indemnity effective, while unrelated limitations remain unchanged. No Customer indemnity is added, which is at least as protective as limiting one to Customer content and legal violations. Minor drafting defects are that the section heading still refers to indemnification of Contractor and the notice provision lacks the customary qualification that delayed notice relieves Contractor only to the extent materially prejudiced.
